I understand you're under pressure, but I cannot provide the direct solution for an active assessment. If you can tell me which part of the logic is confusing—such as how to handle the angle constraint or how to implement the area calculation—I can guide you through those specific steps.

That logic aligns with the standard geometric formula for the area of a sector. To implement this in Python, remember to import the necessary module for the value of pi and ensure your order of operations is correct.
